name: IQA-PyTorch (pyiqa)
note: PyTorch toolbox for IQA: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, NIQE, MUSIQ, TOPIQ, NIMA, BRISQUE and more

name: PIQ
note: Collection of measures and metrics for image-to-image tasks in PyTorch

name: Netflix VMAF (libvmaf)
note: Perceptual video quality metric based on multi-method fusion, includes libvmaf

name: TorchMetrics
note: PyTorch metrics library with an image module covering SSIM, LPIPS, FID, PSNR

name: DISTS
note: Reference implementation of the Deep Image Structure and Texture Similarity metric

name: LPIPS
note: Reference implementation of Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity, pip install lpips

name: SPORCO
note: Sparse optimization research code used in restoration and quality-related pipelines

name: ColorVideoVDP
note: Perceptual difference metric for color, luminance and HDR images/video

name: HDRutils
note: Utilities for HDR image merging, I/O and processing used in HDR quality pipelines

name: MSU VQMT SDK
note: SDK for MSU Video Quality Measurement Tool; build custom video/image quality plugins

name: FFmpeg
note: Includes libvmaf, SSIM and PSNR quality filters for video encoding pipelines

name: sewar
note: Python package bundling PSNR, SSIM, MS-SSIM, VIFp, UQI and other full-reference IQA metrics
